fusions.name: Drowsy Breath
fusions.desc: A slow breath across a cone 4 tiles long that deals 11 damage to everything in it, stuns it for 1.5 seconds and leaves it [Hindered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Drain
fusions.desc: Sends a creeping bolt that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up one of your afflictions on it, and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Hanging Rest
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Settled Calm
fusions.desc: The moment your health is full, your critical hit chance rises by 20% for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
